description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting itself.
Tidewater Minion triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing that much damage to any target.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
